parole.significato: The currency of North Macedonia, divided into 100 deni.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Macedonian денар (denar), from Latin dēnārius. Doublet of denarius, denier, dinar, diner, dinero, and dinheiro.

parole.significato: A subdivision of currency, equal to 0.01 Macedonian denar.
parole.testo: From Macedonian дени (deni) (plurale tantum), from Latin dēnī, from decem.
